title: Critical Values Robust to P-hacking
abstract: P-hacking is prevalent in reality but absent from classical hypothesis-testing theory. We therefore build a model of hypothesis testing that accounts for p-hacking. From the model, we derive critical values such that, if they are used to determine significance, and if p-hacking adjusts to the new significance standards, then spurious significant results do not occur more often than intended. Because of p-hacking, such robust critical values are larger than classical critical values. In the model calibrated to medical science, the robust critical value is the classical critical value for the same test statistic but with one-fifth of the significance level.
abstract_zh: P-hacking在现实中普遍存在，但经典假设检验理论却未将其纳入考量。为此，我们构建了一个考虑P-hacking的假设检验模型。基于该模型，我们推导出临界值：若以此临界值判定统计显著性，且P-hacking行为随新的显著性标准调整，则虚假显著结果的出现频率不会超过预期水平。由于P-hacking的存在，此类稳健临界值大于经典临界值。在基于医学科学校准的模型中，稳健临界值相当于同一检验统计量在显著性水平降至五分之一时的经典临界值。

title: Did the United States Really Grow Out of Its World War II Debt?
title_zh: 美国真的通过经济增长摆脱了二战债务吗？
abstract: This paper examines the effects of primary budget surpluses, surprise inflation, and pegged interest rates before the Fed-Treasury Accord of 1951 on the US public debt/GDP ratio. We find that with the primary budget balance and without distortions in real interest rates caused by surprise inflation and the pre-Accord peg, debt/GDP would have declined only from 106 percent in 1946 to 74 percent in 1974, not to 23 percent as in actual history. Our findings imply that, over the last 76 years, only a small amount of debt reduction has been achieved through growth rates that exceed undistorted interest rates. (JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1951年美联储-财政部协议前，初级预算盈余、意外通胀及钉住利率对美国公共债务/GDP比率的影响。研究发现，若保持初级预算平衡且避免因意外通胀及协议前利率钉住导致的实际利率扭曲，债务/GDP比率仅会从1946年的106%降至1974年的74%，而非实际历史中的23%。我们的结论表明，过去76年间，通过增长率超过未扭曲利率实现的债务削减规模极小。(JEL E23, E31, E43, E65, H61, H63, N12)

title: From urban renewal to urban–rural renewal: exploring new paths for integrated urban–rural development in China
title_zh: 从城市更新到城乡更新：探索中国城乡融合发展的新路径
authors: Chengyou Li, Chuanlei Ji, Zeru Wang
abstract: Integrated urban–rural development (IURD) is an essential requirement for China’s modernization. As a key driver of IURD, urban renewal plays a vital role; therefore, assessing its impact on this process is of great significance. Using panel data from 274 prefecture-level and above cities in China covering 2007–2022, we construct composite indices via the entropy method and employ a two-way fixed-effects model to examine how urban renewal affects IURD. The findings indicate that (1) Urban renewal significantly promotes IURD, a result that remains robust across a battery of robustness checks. (2) The impact of urban renewal on IURD varies across geographic accessibility, urban hierarchy and city size. (3) Urban renewal not only directly influences IURD but also exerts indirect effects by facilitating population mobility and curbing urban sprawl. This study supplements theoretical mechanisms and empirical evidence regarding the impact of urban renewal on IURD, providing policy implications for advancing IURD.
abstract_zh: 城乡融合发展是中国式现代化的必然要求。城市更新作为城乡融合发展的关键驱动力，评估其对这一进程的影响具有重要意义。基于2007—2022年中国274个地级及以上城市的面板数据，采用熵值法构建综合指数，并运用双向固定效应模型考察城市更新对城乡融合发展的影响。研究发现：（1）城市更新显著促进城乡融合发展，该结果在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。（2）城市更新对城乡融合发展的影响因地理可达性、城市等级和城市规模而异。（3）城市更新不仅直接影响城乡融合发展，还通过促进人口流动和抑制城市蔓延产生间接效应。本研究补充了城市更新影响城乡融合发展的理论机制与实证证据，为推进城乡融合发展提供了政策启示。

title: Asset price bubbles and systemic risk in money market funds
title_zh: 资产价格泡沫与货币市场基金的系统性风险
authors: Matteo Aquilina, Peter Cincinelli, Giovanni Urga
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3, 500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.
abstract_zh: 本文以2004年1月至2022年12月美国3,500只货币市场基金为样本，系统考察其在常态时期与资产价格泡沫期间的系统性风险贡献。运用前沿泡沫检测统计技术与基金层面微观数据，研究发现货币市场基金特征对系统性风险具有显著影响。大型货币市场基金及仅投资于美国国债的政府型货币市场基金与较低的系统性风险相关，而优质型货币市场基金则加剧系统性风险。以美元计价但注册于离岸市场的货币市场基金，其系统性风险水平与在岸基金无显著差异。

title: DP21630 Publication Bias and P-Hacking in the Effect of COVID-19 on Learning
title_zh: DP21630 新冠疫情对学习影响的发表偏倚与P值操纵
authors: Martina Luskova, Nino Buliskeria, Ali Elminejad, Tomas Havranek, Zuzana Irsova, Štěpán Jurajda, Marek Kapicka, Martina Luskova; Nino Buliskeria; Ali Elminejad; Tomas Havranek; Zuzana Irsova; Štěpán Jurajda; Marek Kapicka
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We revisit a central estimate in the economics of education: the human-capital loss associated with COVID-19 school closures. Estimates of pandemic learning loss may be affected by publication bias, p-hacking, and the mechanical correlation between standardized effect sizes and their standard errors. We conduct a comprehensive multi-method assessment of bias by applying a wide range of correction techniques, including PET-PEESE, three-parameter selection models (3PSM), Robust Bayesian Meta-Analysis (RoBMA), Meta-Analysis Instrumental Variable Estimation (MAIVE), Right-Truncated Meta-Analysis (RTMA), and multi-bias sensitivity analysis. Our preferred specifications, RoBMA and MAIVE, rely on different assumptions yet converge on an effect size of approximately −0.12 SD, equivalent to a learning loss of about 30% of a school year. Although some methods reveal signs of publication bias and selective reporting, these findings do not explain away the central finding: the COVID-19 learning deficit is economically meaningful and statistically robust.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视教育经济学中的一个核心估计：与新冠疫情学校关闭相关的人力资本损失。对疫情学习损失的估计可能受到发表偏倚、p值操纵以及标准化效应量与其标准误之间机械相关性的影响。我们通过应用多种修正技术，包括PET-PEESE、三参数选择模型（3PSM）、稳健贝叶斯元分析（RoBMA）、元分析工具变量估计（MAIVE）、右截断元分析（RTMA）以及多偏倚敏感性分析，对偏倚进行了全面的多方法评估。我们偏好的设定——RoBMA和MAIVE——基于不同假设，但均收敛于约−0.12个标准差的效应量，相当于约一个学年30%的学习损失。尽管部分方法显示出发表偏倚和选择性报告的证据，但这些发现并未否定核心结论：新冠疫情导致的学习赤字在经济上具有显著意义，且在统计上稳健。

title: How voters choose under the Borda rule: evidence from a post-election survey experiment in Germany 2025
title_zh: 博尔达规则下选民如何选择：来自德国2025年选举后调查实验的证据
abstract: The Borda count offers a promising alternative to counteract the growing polarization of party systems by incentivizing moderate party strategies. However, empirical evidence on the Borda count is still lacking. This paper presents results from an online survey conducted in the aftermath of the 2025 German federal election, in which respondents were asked for their vote choice under a Borda count system. Participants were randomly assigned to one of two conditions: in the first, they could rank up to three out of seven parties; in the second, they could rank all seven parties. The findings show that more ranks considered, the more fragmented the election result. It also shows that the Borda count has mixed effects on policy congruence between voters and parliament. Respondents’ overall acceptance of the Borda rule was moderate to negative, with many of the objections cited were based on misconceptions about the system’s consequences.
abstract_zh: 波达计数法通过激励政党采取温和策略，为应对政党体系日益加剧的两极分化提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，关于波达计数法的实证证据仍然匮乏。本文基于2025年德国联邦大选后开展的一项在线调查，呈现了受访者在波达计数法下的投票选择结果。参与者被随机分配到两种情境之一：第一种情境中，他们最多可对七个政党中的三个进行排序；第二种情境中，他们可对所有七个政党进行排序。研究结果表明，可排序的政党数量越多，选举结果越分散。同时，波达计数法对选民与议会之间的政策一致性产生了混合效应。受访者对波达规则的整体接受度处于中等偏负面水平，且许多反对意见源于对该制度后果的误解。

title: Natural disaster and intergenerational occupational choice in agriculture: Evidence from the US Dust Bowl
title_zh: 自然灾害与农业代际职业选择：来自美国沙尘暴的证据
abstract: This paper examines how a natural disaster, the Dust Bowl, shapes occupational choices in farm households across generations. Using full‐count US census data, I find that young adult sons shift away from self‐employed farming toward wage farm work and nonagricultural sectors after the Dust Bowl. Younger children with affected farming parents are more likely to leave agriculture and earn higher income. Migration and schooling serve as mechanisms, and New Deal relief spending mitigates the Dust Bowl's effects. Overall, the Dust Bowl accelerated occupational reallocation among younger children of farmers and contributed to US mid‐20th century structural change.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了自然灾害“沙尘暴”如何跨代塑造农户家庭的职业选择。利用美国人口普查全量数据，我发现沙尘暴后，年轻成年儿子从自营农业转向雇佣农业劳动和非农部门。受影响的农民家庭中，年幼子女更可能离开农业并获得更高收入。迁移与教育是作用机制，而新政救济支出缓解了沙尘暴的影响。总体而言，沙尘暴加速了农民年轻子女的职业再配置，并推动了美国20世纪中期的结构性变革。

title: Farmland Liquidity Under a Tightened Ownership Regime: Urban–Rural Heterogeneity in South Korea
title_zh: 收紧所有权制度下的农地流动性：韩国的城乡异质性
abstract: In real estate markets featuring substantial search friction and strong seller loss aversion, external shocks that shift buyer valuations are largely reflected in liquidity fluctuations, while price adjustments tend to be rigid. This study examines market liquidity shifts following the tightening of South Korean farmland ownership regulations, utilizing the 2021 Farmland Act amendment and nationwide parcel‐level transaction data (2013−2023). We estimate the relationships between land liquidity, policy change, and key macro variables (i.e. interest rates) using a monthly county fixed‐effects model. We find that the amendment is significantly associated with a 10%−11% reduction in nationwide market liquidity, as measured by the turnover rate. This negative relationship is geographically heterogeneous, being more pronounced in rural areas while statistically insignificant in investment‐driven urban areas. Furthermore, our decomposition analysis reveals that the post‐enforcement drop in observed market liquidity is mostly associated with rising interest rates. The role of interest rates is more dominant in urbanized areas than rural ones, reflecting the higher concentration of investment‐driven buyers and substantial capital requirements for land acquisition in these regions. Our findings demonstrate that the market response to ownership regulation is strongly mediated by local market conditions, highlighting the challenges of enforcing stringent policies in areas with high investment potential.
abstract_zh: 在具有显著搜索摩擦和强烈卖方损失厌恶特征的房地产市场中，改变买方估值的外部冲击主要反映在流动性波动上，而价格调整往往呈现刚性。本研究利用2021年《农地法》修正案及2013-2023年全国地块层面交易数据，考察韩国农地所有权监管收紧后的市场流动性变化。我们采用月度县级固定效应模型，估计土地流动性、政策变化与关键宏观变量（如利率）之间的关系。研究发现，该修正案与全国市场流动性（以周转率衡量）显著下降10%-11%相关。这种负向关系存在地理异质性：在农村地区更为显著，而在投资驱动的城市地区统计上不显著。此外，分解分析表明，政策实施后观察到的市场流动性下降主要与利率上升相关。利率在城市化地区的作用比农村地区更为突出，这反映了这些地区投资驱动型买家的高度集中以及土地收购所需的大量资本。我们的研究结果表明，市场对所有权监管的反应受到当地市场条件的强烈调节，凸显了在高投资潜力地区实施严格政策的挑战。
